# Load Libraries

```{r}
library(TCGAbiolinks)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(dplyr)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(glmnet)
library(pROC)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)
library(tidyr)
library(pec)

load("SKCM.rda")
```

# Prepare Data

```{r}
clinical <- colData(query2) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::select(bcr_patient_barcode, gender, vital_status, days_to_death, age_at_diagnosis, ajcc_pathologic_stage) %>%
  mutate(
    survival_time = ifelse(!is.na(days_to_death), days_to_death / 365, age_at_diagnosis / 365),
    event = ifelse(vital_status == "Dead", 1, 0),
    age_diagnosis = age_at_diagnosis / 365
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(survival_time) & survival_time > 0)

log_expr <- log2(assay(query2, "fpkm_uq_unstrand") + 1)

matched_samples <- intersect(rownames(clinical), colnames(log_expr))
clinical <- clinical[matched_samples, ]
log_expr <- log_expr[, matched_samples]
```

# Feature Selection

```{r}
# select top 1000
top1k <- names(sort(apply(log_expr,1,var),
                    decreasing=TRUE))[1:1000]
expr_filt <- log_expr[top1k, ]

expr_mat  <- t(expr_filt)

surv_data <- as.data.frame(expr_mat) %>%
  mutate(
    survival_time = clinical$survival_time,
    event         = clinical$event
  )
```

# Train/Test Split

```{r}
set.seed(42)
evt_idx  <- which(surv_data$event==1)
cen_idx  <- which(surv_data$event==0)
train_idx <- c(
  sample(evt_idx,  round(0.7*length(evt_idx))),
  sample(cen_idx,  round(0.7*length(cen_idx)))
)
test_idx  <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(surv_data)), train_idx)

train_data <- surv_data[train_idx, ]
test_data  <- surv_data[test_idx, ]
```

# LASSO Cox Model with glmnet

```{r}
# prepare matrices
x_train <- as.matrix(train_data %>% select(-survival_time, -event))
y_train <- Surv(train_data$survival_time, train_data$event)

# cross-validated LASSO Cox
cvfit     <- cv.glmnet(x_train, y_train, family="cox", alpha=1)
lasso_mod <- glmnet(x_train, y_train,
                    family="cox", alpha=1,
                    lambda=cvfit$lambda.min)
```

# Predict and Evaluate

```{r}
# risk scores on test set
x_test <- as.matrix(test_data %>% select(-survival_time, -event))
test_data$risk_score <- as.numeric(
  predict(lasso_mod, newx=x_test, type="link")
)
# dichotomize by median
med_score <- median(test_data$risk_score, na.rm=TRUE)
test_data$risk_group <- factor(
  ifelse(test_data$risk_score>med_score,
         "High","Low"),
  levels=c("Low","High")
)

# concordance index
cindex <- concordance(
  Surv(test_data$survival_time, test_data$event)
  ~ test_data$risk_score
)$concordance

# 1-year ROC/AUC
test_data <- test_data %>%
  mutate(
    surv_1yr = ifelse(survival_time<=1 & event==1, 1, 0),
    valid    = survival_time>=1 |
               (survival_time<1 & event==1)
  )

roc_obj <- roc(test_data$surv_1yr[test_data$valid], test_data$risk_score[test_data$valid])
auc <- as.numeric(auc(roc_obj))
```

# Visualizations

```{r}
# Risk score density
ggplot(test_data, aes(x=risk_score, fill=factor(event))) +
  geom_density(alpha=0.6) + theme_minimal() +
  labs(title="LASSO Cox Risk Score Distribution",
       x="Risk Score", fill="Event")

# KM curve
km_fit <- survfit(Surv(survival_time,event)~risk_group,
                  data=test_data)
print(
  ggsurvplot(km_fit, data=test_data,
             pval=TRUE, risk.table=TRUE,
             title="KM by LASSO Risk Group")
)

# ROC curve
if(!is.na(auc)){
  print(
    ggroc(roc_obj) +
      geom_abline(linetype="dashed") +
      theme_minimal() +
      labs(title="ROC (1-Year Mortality)",
           subtitle=paste("AUC =",round(auc,3)))
  )
} else {
  print(
    ggplot() +
      annotate("text", x=0.5, y=0.5,
               label="Insufficient data for ROC") +
      theme_void()
  )
}
```

# Metrics Summary

```{r}
calib_fit <- coxph(
  Surv(survival_time, event) ~ offset(risk_score) + I(risk_score),
  data = test_data
)
cal_slope <- coef(calib_fit)["I(risk_score)"]


metrics <- data.frame(
  Metric = c(
    "C-index",
    "AUC (1-Year Mortality)",
    "Calibration Slope"
  ),
  Value = c(
    round(cindex, 3),
    round(auc,    3),
    round(cal_slope,      3)
  )
)

knitr::kable(metrics, caption = "Lasso Cox Model Evaluation Metrics")
```
```{r}
# Calculate number of selected genes (non-zero coefficients)
coef_lasso <- coef(lasso_mod)


num_selected_genes <- sum(coef_lasso != 0) - 1  
cat("Number of Selected Genes:", num_selected_genes, "\n")
```
```{r}
save(lasso_mod, clinical, expr_filt, file = "lasso.RData")
```
